label: Open Policy Agent

operations.description: Read a policy module and its AST.

operations.description: Read a base or virtual document without input.

operations.name: evaluate_document
operations.description: Evaluate a decision with input wrapped in the v1 input envelope.

operations.name: put_document
operations.description: Create or replace base data at a document path.

operations.description: Apply an atomic JSON Patch to base data.

operations.name: delete_document
operations.description: Delete base data at a document path.

operations.name: post_query

operations.name: compile_query
